description: This file implements the TalkModeRuntime actor, responsible for voice recognition, speech synthesis, and integrating speech-related functionalities within the openclaw project. It manages configuration, recognition state, speech playback, and interactions with external APIs and system components for a voice-enabled 'talk' mode.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: The primary actor class managing speech recognition, TTS, and configuration for the voice interaction mode within the app. It encapsulates recognition lifecycle, speech playback, and configuration fetching.

classes.name: RMSMeter
classes.description: A helper class for measuring RMS audio levels in a thread-safe manner, used for voice activity detection.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the recognition and playback functionalities.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the recognition cycle, stopping recognition if paused.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition process.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech recognition and cleans up related resources.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updating internal state and triggering responses or further processing.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if a sufficient silence period has elapsed to finalize the current transcript.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends the transcript to the backend API and handles the assistant's response, including TTS playback.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles playback of the assistant's response text via TTS or system voice.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration for voice, model, and other settings from the backend or environment.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates RMS noise floor estimates based on incoming audio levels to detect speech activity.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves a preferred voice alias or ID into a usable voice ID for TTS.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if current recognition should be interrupted based on new speech input.
